PlaybackStatus.description: `playing`, `paused`, `buffering` (loading or waiting for data; playback resumes by itself) or `stopped` (nothing loaded).

RepeatMode.description: `off`, `all` (repeat the queue) or `one` (repeat the current item).

EpisodeRate.description: A playback speed for podcast episodes. Tracks always play at 1.

PlayerState.description: Everything about the player at one moment.

item.description: The current item, or null when nothing is loaded.

positionMs.description: The playback position when the state was taken.

positionAt.description: When `positionMs` was measured. While `status` is `playing`, the position now is `positionMs + (now - positionAt) * rate`.

durationMs.description: The current item's length, or null when unknown or nothing is loaded.

rate.description: The speed the current item plays at: 1 for tracks, `episodeRate` for episodes.

queueIndex.description: The current item's index in the queue, or null when the queue is empty.

autoplay.description: Whether Sonolith adds related tracks when the queue runs out.

QueueEntry.description: One entry in the queue. `entryId` identifies this occurrence (the queue can hold the same track twice) and stays the same when entries move.

autoplay.description: True when autoplay added it (related tracks after the user's own).

QueueSummary.description: The queue's shape without its items.

revision.description: Grows by at least one whenever the entries or `currentIndex` change. Compare revisions to know whether a copy is current.

currentIndex.description: The index of the current item, or null when the queue is empty.

QueueChangeReason.description: Why the queue changed. Treat unknown values as `other`.
